name: Mostly Hard Python Problems (MHPP)
description: MHPP is a dataset of 210 unique human-curated Python coding problems designed to evaluate language models' abilities in natural language understanding, multi-step reasoning, and code generation beyond basic function-level tasks. It aims to address limitations in existing benchmarks by focusing on problem quality, difficulty, and granularity.
reputation: A niche but well-regarded curated coding benchmark for harder Python problems, mainly used in research evaluations rather than broad community leaderboards.
notes: Focuses on multi-step reasoning and coding knowledge application; highlights limitations of existing benchmarks like HumanEval and MBPP.
